description: Split from fz-kdt.177.7 after the 2026-09-17 runtime-boundary spike established two independently-verifiable changes. Project a canonical regular Ty into a finite component-local RuntimeTypePredicate graph keyed by Ty, with back-edges by node id and no new global type/equivalence authority. Relations use semantic node-pair fixed points: containment coinductive; overlap and erasing-overlap inductive. Replace the tree-only matcher with exact finite-value evaluation of that graph. Lower one shared evaluator through runtime_test for Prim and receive; branching recursive predicates such as μX. :leaf | {X, X} require an explicit work/continuation stack or a generated recursive helper, not a node-only CFG or active-node success cut. Preserve current acyclic semantics. Tests: self/mutual recursive tuple/list/capture projection; relation and matcher properties against finite unrollings; interpreter/JIT/AOT parity through both primitive and receive paths. This ticket does not change semantic return-ladder telemetry; .177.9/.10 own it.
title: Finite runtime predicate graph and all-door evaluator
